meta.name: add-dashboard
meta.description: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw. Installs @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard and a pusher that sends periodic JSON snapshots.

copy.tagline: 为 NanoClaw 添加监控仪表盘并推送数据快照
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 NanoClaw 并需要可视化运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Add a monitoring dashboard and push data snapshots to NanoClaw
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NanoClaw and need to visualize its runtime status

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会为 NanoClaw 添加一个本地监控仪表盘，显示智能体分组、会话、频道、用户、Token 用量、上下文窗口、消息活动和实时日志。数据每 60 秒推送一次。
howto.when: 当你要求“给 NanoClaw 添加仪表盘”或说“使用 add-dashboard 技能”时触发。

say.text: 请为 NanoClaw 添加一个监控仪表盘。
帮我的 NanoClaw 安装仪表盘。
say.note: 执行安装步骤，包括依赖、代码和配置。

say.text: 给我的 NanoClaw 加上实时监控面板。
say.note: 会安装 pusher 和 dashboard 包。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude adds a local monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw showing agent groups, sessions, channels, users, token usage, context windows, message activity, and real-time logs. Data is pushed every 60 seconds.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add a dashboard to NanoClaw or say /add-dashboard.

say_en.text: Please add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: After installation, open http://localhost:3100/dashboard in a browser.

say_en.text: Set up the dashboard for my NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Runs the installation steps including dependencies, code, and config.

say_en.text: Add a real-time monitoring panel to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Installs the pusher and dashboard packages.
